items.title: 68097_Freddie Green oral history interview
items.q: Buck and I used to be roommates

ctx.x: And, I walked in, and I think they were setting up the mikes, and what-not. And, then in walks -- I think Pres walked in first, and then Buck walked in, you know. And then came Benny.

items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: Basie, no Freddie Greene? Oh no, you had Claude Williams? Yes, that's right. Yes, we did have Claude. ... We had made a picture in California and I had lost my, my card. ... And Freddie Greene had lost his out in California when we were making a movie.

ctx.x: : Well, this band which left Kansas City consisted of what? Of Lester, Herschel, (Coughy) Roberts?
